prompt: Some think that developing a successful career is more important than spending time with family and friends, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give our own opinion.
essay:
It is often argued that spending time with people whom we love is less crucial than being successful in a career. While some people agree with this idea, others believe this is not an acceptable approach. This essay will discuss both sides of the argument and explain why I support the second view.

There are several reasons why some people agree with this idea. One of the main reasons is that career development plays a significant role in the financial situation of households. This means that a better job position offers a higher salary, which can have a positive impact on the household’s living standards. Another important point is that being successful in a career gives individuals a sense of self-confidence. This is particularly beneficial because it can improve their mental well-being. For Example, a person who is promoted to a higher position at work usually has a better perspective on their abilities and skills. 

On the other hand, some individuals disagree with this approach. One major reason for this is that spending quality time with family and friends can reduce anxiety levels, which can positively affect individuals’ mental health and productivity. In addition, a better life-work balance is another important factor. If this view is accepted, it is likely to lead to an improvement in life satisfaction. For instance, a person who has  good communication with his friends and family due to spending quality time with them, as well as being relatively successful at work, may have  higher satisfaction with his life. 

In conclusion,  both sides of the argument have valid reasons. However, I believe that the second view is more convincing due to factors such as anxiety reduction and higher life satisfaction.
